title: fix(components,plugin-list): the Sort picker lists a field it keeps only for the current sort as removable only (objectui#11943)
body:
Fixes #11943
Clause-②: yes — this widens a published prop type of `@object-ui/components`: `SortBuilderProps.fields` entries gain an optional `disabled` (one optional key; existing callers never pass it and behave as before).

The list's Sort picker now lists a field it keeps only because the current sort names it as **removable only**: marked unavailable, never offered as a new choice. This is the half objectui#11962 left (triage's ruling on the card, direction A1 from the retriage). With objectui#11962's read check already on `main`, it completes the card.

## What changes

- **`SortBuilder` (`packages/components/src/custom/sort-builder.tsx`).** A `fields` entry takes an optional `disabled`. It is passed to `SelectItem`, so every row's dropdown draws the entry as an unavailable option (`aria-disabled="true"`, `data-disabled`) that cannot be chosen by click or keyboard. A row whose current field it is still shows its label, and can be changed to another field or removed. *Add sort* seeds the first entry that is not disabled, and is disabled when no entry is choosable (it was disabled only for an empty list). No i18n key, so A2 is not taken.
- **`ListView`'s `sortFields` memo (`packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`).** An entry carries `disabled: true` exactly when the in-use exception alone keeps it: unreadable (`canReadField` denies), relational (listed with the by-ID suffix), or refused by the served projection (or, with no projection served, by the type read). A field the two rules list anyway carries no flag, whether or not the sort names it. Every entry it listed before is still listed with the same label: only the flag is new.
- **Comments.** The block above `sortFields` and the `effectiveFields` comment stop promising a follow-up and state what holds. The `canReadField` docblock makes no such promise and is unchanged.
- **The objectui#11962 in-use pin** (`ListView.sortFieldRead-11943.test.tsx`, "a field the current sort already names stays listed") keeps its assertions. Its title and comment stop describing the half-state this change ends.
- Changeset `.changeset/11943-sort-in-use-removable-only.md`: `@object-ui/components` minor (an additive optional prop), `@object-ui/plugin-list` patch.

## The dispatch's mechanism assumptions, measured

- **H1 holds.** Through the real `SortBuilder` and its Radix `Select` (`sort-builder-disabled-entry-11943.test.tsx`), each beside a control that runs the same interaction on the same entry without the flag: the flagged option renders `aria-disabled="true"` and `data-disabled` (control: neither); click and mouse pointer-up choose nothing and the list stays open (control: chosen); Enter on the option and typeahead on the closed trigger skip it (control: chosen); a row whose value is the flagged entry shows its label (control: a value with no entry renders blank), can be changed to another field, and can be removed.
- **H2 holds for all three cases, and each is flagged.** `ListView.sortRemovableOnly-11943.test.tsx` runs the same sequence for an unreadable in-use field, a platform-refused in-use field (served projection, as objectui#6455's pins serve it) and a relational in-use field (`Owner (by ID)`), each declared first on the object so an unflagged *Add sort* would seed it: listed disabled and nothing else is; its row shows its label; *Add sort* seeds `Title`; the new row offers it only as unavailable and choosing it changes nothing; removing its row drops it from the list. The relational case is flagged too: objectui#4243 took relational fields out of the picker as new choices, and the in-use entry exists only so its row is not blank and the sort survives an edit. Flagging it keeps that row as it was and stops other rows re-offering it. Controls: a readable sortable field in use carries no flag and *Add sort* still seeds the first entry; with full read and no projection, the same unreadable and refused fields are ordinary options.
- **H3 holds.** `emitSortChange` is untouched, and its docblock is still true. The five objectui#11962 pins ran **unedited** and green on the committed fix `a64e78e`: `Test Files 1 failed | 3 passed (4)`, `Tests 4 failed | 18 passed (22)`, where the one failing file was a temporary measurement probe (below) and the pin file passed 5 of 5. They stayed green under every mutation below. Only pin 4's prose was edited afterwards.
- **H4 holds.** `config-field-renderer.tsx` passes `field.fields`, whose `ConfigField` type declares no `disabled`; `plugin-view`'s `SortUI.tsx` and app-shell's `ObjectListViewInspector.tsx` map to `{ value, label }` explicitly. Their existing tests ran unedited in the union below.

## Reverse check

On the committed fix `2b80540`, each mutation landed and was restored through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed; restore blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty), running the two new files plus the objectui#11962 file (17 tests). Baseline: `Tests 17 passed (17)`.

| Mutation | Predicted red | Observed |
|---|---|---|
| M1: `SortBuilder` stops passing `disabled` to `SelectItem` | 3 SortBuilder (mark, click, keyboard) + the 3 ListView cases | `Tests 6 failed / 11 passed (17)`: exactly those |
| M2: *Add sort* seeds `fields[0]` again | SortBuilder seed case + the 3 ListView cases | `Tests 4 failed / 13 passed (17)`: exactly those |
| M3: *Add sort* disabled only for an empty list | SortBuilder *Add sort* gate case | `Tests 1 failed / 16 passed (17)` |
| M4: `ListView` drops `disabled: true` from the in-use entry | the 3 ListView cases | `Tests 3 failed / 14 passed (17)` |
| M5: an unreadable in-use field that the rules would list goes through the unflagged branch | the unreadable case only | `Tests 1 failed / 16 passed (17)`: the unreadable case |

**Cross-package type, read from the rebuilt `.d.ts`.** After the closure build, `packages/components/dist/custom/sort-builder.d.ts` declares `disabled?: boolean`. A temporary file in `plugin-list` (deleted by trap; `git status` empty after) passing `disabled: 'no'` answers `TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'boolean | undefined'` (a stale `.d.ts` answers an excess-property error instead), and `disabled: true` compiles.

The narrowing: no file under `skills/`, `content/docs/` or any `README.md` names `SortBuilder` or `sort-builder` (`git grep` zero hits; control `FilterBuilder` / `GroupingEditor` hits), and no export name moves. Warnings equal their base blobs linted over stdin (`sort-builder.tsx` 2, `ListView.tsx` 199, the objectui#11962 pin 0); the two new tests 0. `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (`tseslint.configs.recommended`, no parser project), and nothing under `eslint-rules/` reads the file system, so untouched files cannot move. Repo-wide lint is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **The hide-fields popover, measured** (the retriage asked; ⛔ not fixed here). With objectui#11962's `MePermissionsProvider` set-up and a column list carrying labels, in a temporary probe deleted after the run: the Sort picker withholds `Secret Note` (`[Title, Status, Priority]`, so the read answer is loaded and denying), while the hide-fields popover lists `[Title, Status, Secret Note]`. The same `allFields` list feeds the *Group* editor's field options (shown by default) and the *Row color* field select: both offer `Secret Note` too. With full read the lists are the same. Reported for the seat to file.
- No doc page or README describes `SortBuilder`, so no doc changes.
- The `SortBuilderProps` edit also drops one trailing space on the `fields` line.
